meta.title: Small software, private by default
meta.description: MonoOne makes IndexOne, private meeting notes for macOS; RigOne, a control room for coding agents; and SurfaceOne, a design system for Angular and Vue. All free.

hero.description: We build tools that keep your data on your device and leave you with files you own.

principles.title: What we believe
principles.description: Four rules every MonoOne product follows. No exceptions, no fine print.

localFirst.title: Local-first
localFirst.description: Your data stays on your device. Everything core works offline and without an account.

ownFiles.title: Files you own
ownFiles.description: Plain Markdown on disk. No proprietary formats, no lock-in, no export ritual.

private.title: Private by default
private.description: Cloud features are opt-in and redacted. Sharing is end-to-end encrypted.

mac.title: Mac and web
mac.description: Native Mac apps, signed and notarized. SurfaceOne is plain CSS with Angular and Vue components for any web app.

projects.title: Projects
projects.description: Three focused products, built carefully. More when they're ready.

page.title: Projects
page.description: Everything we ship today: what each product does, who it is for and how it works. All free.

upcoming.headline: Next
upcoming.title: In the works
upcoming.description: Two more products are on the way. We'll say more when they're ready.

indexOne.tagline: Secure, 100% local meeting notes for macOS.
indexOne.description: IndexOne records your calls, transcribes them and writes a structured note you own as plain Markdown, all on your Mac. Recordings, transcripts and notes stay 100% on your device: no account and no cloud processing. Your library sits in an encrypted database, and nothing is sent anywhere unless you explicitly choose to.
indexOne.audience: People who spend their day in calls and want notes they own, without sending audio to a cloud.

bothSides.title: Both sides of the call
bothSides.description: Your mic and the other side, merged into one clear transcript.

whisper.title: On-device Whisper
whisper.description: Transcription runs locally with Metal. No cloud transcription.

notes.title: Notes you own
notes.description: Summary, decisions and action items as Markdown in your Obsidian vault.

answers.title: Answers with sources
answers.description: Ask mid-call or months later and see which meetings each answer came from.

encrypted.title: Encrypted and lockable
encrypted.description: One encrypted database on your Mac, plus per-folder Touch ID locks.

ai.title: Your AI, your choice
ai.description: On-device model or opt-in cloud. A local MCP server for your own agents.

record.title: Record
record.description: Start a recording. IndexOne hears your mic and the other side of the call.

transcribe.title: Transcribe
transcribe.description: On-device Whisper turns the call into a Me / Others transcript on your Mac.

keep.title: Keep and ask
keep.description: A structured Markdown note lands in your vault. Ask across every meeting later.

rigOne.tagline: A native macOS control room for coding agents.
rigOne.description: RigOne turns a row of coding agents into one graph you can see. Define an agent once, place it on a canvas, connect the steps, and run the graph against a folder on your Mac. Claude Code and Codex are first-class peers, independent branches really do run at the same time, and the evidence of a run outlives the terminal it came from.
rigOne.audience: Developers who run several coding agents and want to see, and repeat, how the work gets done.

canvas.title: Visual workflows
canvas.description: Agent steps, commands, checks, loops and retries, saved as a graph you run again.

parallel.title: Real parallel execution
parallel.description: Independent branches overlap in time instead of queueing behind one worker.

watch.title: A run you can read
watch.description: The plan on one side, what every agent said on the other, questions pinned.

agents.title: Reusable agents
agents.description: Vendor, model, file access, tools and skills: chosen once per role.

context.title: Project-scoped knowledge
context.description: Instructions and notes on disk, and proof of what a run actually used.

evidence.title: Evidence that lasts
evidence.description: Receipts, handoffs and diagnostics stay after the output is gone.

define.title: Define agents
define.description: Give each agent a role, a model and its file access, once.

connect.title: Connect the steps
connect.description: Place agents, checks and commands on a canvas and wire them into a graph.

run.title: Run and watch
run.description: Run the graph against a project and follow every agent on one screen.

surfaceOne.tagline: A design system and component library for Angular and Vue.
surfaceOne.description: SurfaceOne is a design system and component library that any app can use. Design tokens and skins ship as plain CSS; Angular and Vue / Nuxt components sit on top, and React is planned on the same tokens. Over 70 components, from forms and overlays to charts, graphs and recording controls.
surfaceOne.audience: Teams building Angular or Vue apps who want one consistent look without writing a design system from scratch.

tokens.title: Design tokens
tokens.description: Framework-agnostic CSS: colors, type, spacing and self-hosted fonts.

skins.title: Three skins, five accents
skins.description: Studio, Paper and Minimalist, each in light and dark.

components.title: Angular and Vue components
components.description: Signal-first Angular parts with Vue 3 and Nuxt twins, one entry point per component.

docs.title: Docs and Storybook
docs.description: Docs in nine languages with Angular and Vue code, every component in Storybook, checked with axe-core.

mcp.title: MCP server
mcp.description: Gives your AI assistant the components, their API, templates and theme variables.

skills.title: Agent skills
skills.description: One command installs SurfaceOne skills for Claude, Codex and Copilot.

install.title: Install
install.description: Add the tokens package and the components for Angular or Vue.

theme.title: Pick a look
theme.description: Choose a skin and an accent, in light and dark.

build.title: Build
build.description: Use the same components and tokens across your app, documented in Storybook.

contact.title: Found a bug or have an idea?
contact.description: We build in the open. Issues and discussions live on GitHub.
